title: The adaptive three-tier engine
transcript: JEVDB v1 Figure 1, PDF p.5; §2 prior approaches · Original figure, CC BY 4.0
noteKo: Tier 1은 후보를 줄이고, Tier 2는 Jev의 직접 판단 또는 문서별 interpretation 재사용으로 점수를 만듭니다. Full JEVDB는 불확실한 후보를 Tier 3 reasoning LLM에 넘깁니다.
noteEn: Tier 1 reduces candidates. Tier 2 scores them through direct Jev decisions or reused document interpretations. Full JEVDB sends uncertain candidates to a Tier 3 reasoning LLM.
source: JEVDB v1 Figure 1, PDF p.5; §2 prior approaches · Original figure, CC BY 4.0

title: Map semantic operators to Jev
transcript: RELATIONAL–SEMANTIC ALGEBRA MAPPING · THE OUTPUT FOLLOWS THE OPERATOR
Choice selects the most likely class.
Use the category to group reports.
Score averages ordered levels by probability.
Use the degree to rank reports.
JEVDB v1 §3.1, Table 1, Eqs. (1)–(5) · Illustrative report/bulletin predicate
noteKo: Filter와 join은 Noul, classification은 Choice, ranking은 Score에 연결됩니다. DB는 반환된 값으로 행을 선택하고 결과를 구성합니다.
noteEn: Filter and join map to Noul, classification to Choice, and ranking to Score. The DB uses those returned values to select rows and construct results.
source: JEVDB v1 §3.1, Table 1, Eqs. (1)–(5) · Illustrative report/bulletin predicate

title: Prune with relational structure
transcript: E denotes reports. R1–R3 are our illustrative survivors, not rows from the paper’s dataset.
JEVDB v1 Figure 1 (Tier 1 crop), PDF p.5; §3.2 · Original figure
noteKo: 명시된 key와 조건으로 relational region을 먼저 축소합니다. 살아남은 보고서와 공지의 semantic match는 아직 판단되지 않았습니다. R1–R3는 발표용 예시입니다.
noteEn: Explicit keys and conditions reduce the relational region first. Semantic matches between surviving reports and bulletins remain unknown. R1–R3 are illustrative survivors.
source: JEVDB v1 Figure 1 (Tier 1 crop), PDF p.5; §3.2 · Original figure

title: Screen pairs with necessary conditions
transcript: Registered condition: a valid defect match requires compatible components.
ADD A DISPLAY BULLETIN · PAIRWISE SCREEN
Unknowns stay. Lossless pruning requires a sound condition
JEVDB v1 §3.2.1, Figure 1 (SBF detail), PDF p.5 · Original crop, CC BY 4.0 · Right: illustrative pairs
noteKo: 부품 호환 조건이 타당하다면 맞지 않는 조합을 제외할 수 있습니다. Unknown은 남겨야 합니다. Lossless pruning은 조건과 속성 추출이 모두 타당할 때 성립합니다.
noteEn: A sound component-compatibility condition can exclude mismatching pairs. Unknown attributes must remain eligible. Lossless pruning depends on both sound conditions and sound attribute extraction.
scopeEn: 6 → 4 is illustrative · not a benchmark result
source: JEVDB v1 §3.2.1, Figure 1 (SBF detail), PDF p.5 · Original crop, CC BY 4.0 · Right: illustrative pairs

title: Reuse judgments, preserve result rows
transcript: R1–B1 CAN OCCUR IN MULTIPLE RESULT ROWS
Predicate: the bulletin covers the reported defect.
One distinct input → one cached decision
Exact inputs · one query · pointwise predicate
JEVDB v1 §3.2.3, Eq. (11), Figure 1 (deduplication detail), PDF p.5 · Original crop, CC BY 4.0 · Illustrative rows
noteKo: 입력이 같은 판단은 한 번 계산해 재사용해도 결과 행 A와 B는 별개입니다. 이 예시는 한 query 안의 exact input과 pointwise predicate를 전제로 합니다.
noteEn: Identical decision inputs can share one cached judgment while result rows A and B remain distinct. This example assumes exact inputs and a pointwise predicate within one query.
scopeKo: Exact input · one query · pointwise predicate
scopeEn: Exact input · one query · pointwise predicate
source: JEVDB v1 §3.2.3, Eq. (11), Figure 1 (deduplication detail), PDF p.5 · Original crop, CC BY 4.0 · Illustrative rows

title: Batch requests, share repeated text
transcript: Same two judgments. Pack reduces requests; star also shares the repeated bulletin.
Back to the B1 column: R1–B1 and R3–B1 survive screening and remain distinct inputs.
JEVDB v1 Figure 1, PDF p.5; §3.3.1–3.3.2 · Original figure, CC BY 4.0 · B1/R1/R3: illustrative inputs
noteKo: SEP, PACK, STAR는 같은 두 판단을 배치하는 방식이 다릅니다. PACK은 요청을 묶고, STAR는 반복 공지 텍스트도 공유합니다.
noteEn: SEP, PACK, and STAR arrange the same two judgments differently. PACK groups requests; STAR also shares the repeated bulletin text.
source: JEVDB v1 Figure 1, PDF p.5; §3.3.1–3.3.2 · Original figure, CC BY 4.0 · B1/R1/R3: illustrative inputs

title: LLM escalation for uncertain pairs
transcript: LLM ESCALATION · CALIBRATED FOR EACH PREDICATE
Full JEVDB calibrates a band against sampled LLM labels.
400 samples per predicate. Allowed recall / precision loss: 0.05 each, relative to the judge.
Confident errors can still bypass the LLM.
JEVDB-Flash uses a fixed 0.5 threshold and makes no reasoning calls.
JEVDB v1 §3.3.3, Eqs.12–13; §4.1 · Direct Jev path; threshold positions are schematic
noteKo: Full JEVDB는 predicate별로 보정한 불확실 구간을 escalation합니다. Flash는 고정 0.5 threshold를 쓰며 reasoning 호출이 없습니다. 확신을 가진 오판은 escalation을 통과하지 않을 수 있습니다.
noteEn: Full JEVDB escalates a predicate-calibrated uncertainty band. Flash uses a fixed 0.5 threshold with no reasoning calls. Confident errors can bypass escalation.
scopeEn: 400 samples per predicate · threshold positions are schematic
source: JEVDB v1 §3.3.3, Eqs.12–13; §4.1 · Direct Jev path; threshold positions are schematic

title: Reuse each document’s interpretation
transcript: TWO ALTERNATIVES FOR THE FIRST SCORE · NOT TWO SUCCESSIVE STAGES
Pairwise model reads in a full candidate space.
Pruning reduces the pairs actually read.
Interpret n reports and m bulletins once.
Combine stored distributions for each pair.
The index-derived score can replace direct Noul before accept, reject, or escalation.
20,558 documents · 15 s / $0.54 build · pair management and escalation remain
§3.3.4 leaves the combination function and score-specific calibration unspecified.
JEVDB v1 §3.3.4, §4.1 · First-stage inference counts for a full bipartite candidate space; not total query complexity
noteKo: Direct Noul과 index-derived score는 첫 점수를 만드는 대안입니다. n + m은 문서별 첫 inference 횟수이며 전체 query 복잡도가 아닙니다. Pair 관리와 escalation은 남습니다.
noteEn: Direct Noul and an index-derived score are alternatives for the first score. The n + m count covers initial document inference, not total query complexity. Pair management and escalation remain.
scopeEn: Combination function and score-specific calibration unspecified
source: JEVDB v1 §3.3.4, §4.1 · First-stage inference counts for a full bipartite candidate space; not total query complexity

How were the reference answers produced and checked?

noteEn: For M Q4, full JEVDB reports higher F1 and longer execution than Flash. S/M query cost excludes 15 s / $0.54 of index setup. The paper does not specify how reference answers were produced and checked.

title: Research perspective: verification costs
transcript: Choice flags it. Astra repairs. The verifier rechecks.
One run per case and setting
Agent loop only. No low-confidence Astra escalation configured. Shared-account load uncontrolled.
U8c · artifact 3bcf4044 · 18 matched cases, one run each · Theory: When Plans Change Answers v2 §4 · Agent-task result, not JEVDB
noteKo: GEODE U8c의 6 tasks × 3 defect conditions, 18 matched cases입니다. Astra가 실행·수리하고 completion verifier를 교체했습니다. −18.17 s는 agent loop의 paired runtime 차이 중앙값이며 per-call 지연이 아닙니다.
noteEn: GEODE U8c covers six tasks × three defect conditions, or 18 matched cases. Astra executes and repairs while the completion verifier changes. −18.17 s is the median paired agent-loop runtime difference, not per-call latency.
scopeKo: 각 case·조건 1회 · 양쪽 strict success 18/18 · 공유 계정 부하 미통제 · JEVDB 재현 아님
scopeEn: One run per case and setting · 18/18 strict success each · shared-account load uncontrolled · not a JEVDB reproduction

title: JEVDB reduces the work of inference
transcript: JEVDB reduces the work of inference
Shelob: higher quality can require more time
Plan the cost of a result whose quality has been checked.
JEVDB v1 §§3–5 · SemBench §4.2; Shelob §4.3 M totals · Presenter synthesis; index setup separate
noteKo: 후보 축소, typed decision과 재사용, 불확실성 기반 escalation을 함께 읽어야 합니다. SemBench의 빠른 실행과 Shelob의 품질·시간 tradeoff를 구분해, 품질이 검증된 결과의 비용을 묻습니다.
noteEn: Read pruning, typed decisions and reuse, and uncertainty-based escalation together. Distinguish fast SemBench execution from Shelob’s quality–time tradeoff when asking what a quality-checked result costs.
